Class VariantAttributesBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.commercetools.api.models.variant_attributes.VariantAttributesBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Builder<VariantAttributes>
public class VariantAttributesBuilder extends Object implements Builder<VariantAttributes>
VariantAttributesBuilder
Example to create an instance using the builder pattern 

     VariantAttributes variantAttributes = VariantAttributes.builder()
             .productId("{productId}")
             .plusAttributes(attributesBuilder -> attributesBuilder)
             .plusVariants(variantsBuilder -> variantsBuilder)
             .build()
